description: NEWA—Network for Environment and Weather Applications is a decision-support tool listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by New York State Integrated Pest Management Program; Cornell University Northeast Regional Climate Center; Cornell University. This website retrieves data from on-farm, grower-owned weather stations throughout the Northeast and in a number of other locations across the U.S. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Vector-Borne Disease, Drought, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply. The listed link gives the project or repository page; nothing was installed or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
